ai.en: Hello! Can I help you?

ai.zh: 往前走，车站在学校旁边。
ai.en: Go straight ahead. The station is next to the school.
Not far, ten minutes on foot.
Good. Please go straight ahead; do not turn right.
You are welcome! Goodbye!

you.en: Excuse me, where is the station?
Is it far from here?
Okay, I will walk.
Okay, thank you!

ai.en: Hello! What would you like to drink?

ai.zh: 好的。你想喝热的还是冷的？
ai.en: Okay. Would you like it hot or cold?

ai.zh: 好。你想吃东西吗？我们有面。
ai.en: Okay. Would you like something to eat? We have noodles.
Okay. Forty yuan.
Thank you! Goodbye!

you.en: I would like black tea.
I would like it hot.
Okay, I would like noodles.
Okay, here you are.

ai.en: Hello! What is wrong with you?
Have you eaten today?

ai.zh: 你要多休息。这个药，一天吃三次。
ai.en: You need to rest more. Take this medicine three times a day.
Take it after you finish eating.
You are welcome, goodbye!

you.en: I have a headache and I do not feel well.

you.zh: 吃了，但是我不想吃东西。
you.en: I ate, but I do not want anything to eat.
Okay, when do I take it?
Thank you, goodbye.

ai.en: Hello! What are your hobbies?
Do you swim often?
Great! Do you like playing basketball?

ai.zh: 我也喜欢足球！我们一起踢吧。
ai.en: I like soccer too! Let us play together.
Wonderful!

you.zh: 我喜欢游泳，我也喜欢跳舞。
you.en: I like swimming, and I like dancing too.
I swim every morning.

you.zh: 不太喜欢，我喜欢踢足球。
you.en: Not really; I like playing soccer.
Great, let us go together!

ai.en: Hello! Where are you going?
Okay. What time is your flight?

ai.zh: 没问题。路上不远，我们很快就到。
ai.en: No problem. It is not far, we will be there soon.
Okay. We have arrived!
One hundred yuan.

you.en: I am going to the airport.
Three in the afternoon.
Great, please drive a little faster.
Thanks, how much is it?

scenarios.title: A friend's birthday
goals: Say what you want to drink

ai.en: Today is my birthday!

ai.zh: 谢谢！你真好。你想喝茶还是咖啡？
ai.en: Thank you! You are so kind. Would you like tea or coffee?

ai.zh: 我们一起去饭馆吃饭吧。
ai.en: Let us go to a restaurant together.
Six in the evening, next to the station.
Great, see you in the evening!

you.zh: 生日快乐！我送你一本书。
you.en: Happy birthday! I am giving you a book.
I would like tea.
Sure, when are we going?
Okay, I will be there at six.

scenarios.title: Talk about an exam
goals: Say what you are doing and ask for help

ai.zh: 明天有汉语考试，你准备好了吗？
ai.en: There is a Chinese exam tomorrow. Have you prepared?
What are you doing now?
Sure, I will teach you.
This word means friend.
You are welcome, see you tomorrow.

you.en: Not yet, and I am a little tired.

you.zh: 我正在看书，你可以帮我吗？
you.en: I am reading. Can you help me?
What does this word mean?
I understand now, thank you!

scenarios.title: Buy trousers
goals: Say what you want to buy
Say it is too big and ask for a smaller one

ai.en: Hello! What would you like to buy?
What colour do you like?
How about this one?

ai.zh: 有。这条小的很漂亮，二百块。
ai.en: Yes. This small one is very nice, two hundred yuan.
Okay, one hundred and eighty yuan.

you.en: I want to buy a pair of trousers.
I like black ones.
It is a bit big. Do you have a smaller one?
That is too expensive, make it cheaper.

scenarios.title: Buy a book
goals: Say what you want to buy
Ask if you can read here for a while

ai.en: Hello! What book would you like to buy?

ai.zh: 好的。这本五十块，那本八十块。你要哪本？
ai.en: Okay. This one is 50 yuan and that one is 80 yuan. Which one do you want?
Okay, 50 yuan.
Yes, you can; there are chairs over there.
You are welcome!

you.en: I would like to buy a Chinese book.
I want this one.

you.zh: 我可以在这儿看一会儿吗？
you.en: Can I read here for a while?
Okay, thank you!

scenarios.title: Go to a film with a friend

ai.zh: 喂，你好！我是小明。你明天下午有时间吗？
ai.en: Hello! I am Xiao Ming. Are you free tomorrow afternoon?

ai.zh: 我想请你去看电影。你想看什么电影？
ai.en: I would like to invite you to a film. What film would you like to see?

ai.zh: 好啊，明天下午有一个很好的中国电影。
ai.en: Great, there is a very good Chinese film tomorrow afternoon.

alt.zh: 好啊，明天下午有一个很好的外国电影。
alt.en: Great, there is a very good foreign film tomorrow afternoon.

ai.zh: 三点。我们两点半在电影院门口见，好吗？
ai.en: Three o'clock. Let's meet at the cinema entrance at half past two, okay?
See you tomorrow!

you.en: I have time. What is it?
I would like to see a Chinese film.

alt.en: I would like to see a foreign film.

you.en: What time does the film start?
Okay, see you tomorrow!

scenarios.title: Order at a café: a bad day
goals: Say it is the wrong drink

ai.en: Hello! What would you like to drink?

ai.zh: 对不起，红茶没有了。我们有绿茶和咖啡。
ai.en: Sorry, there is no black tea left. We have green tea and coffee.
Okay, your green tea has come.

ai.zh: 啊，对不起！我再给你做一杯绿茶。
ai.en: Oh, sorry! I will make you another cup of green tea.
You are welcome. This cup does not cost money.

you.en: I would like to drink black tea.
Then I will have green tea.

you.zh: 对不起，这是咖啡，不是绿茶。
you.en: Sorry, this is coffee, not green tea.
It does not matter, thank you.

scenarios.title: Go to the airport: a bad day
goals: Say your flight time and ask to hurry
Ask when you will get there

ai.en: Hello! Where are you going?
Okay. What time is your plane?

ai.zh: 对不起，路上车太多了，我们走得很慢。
ai.en: Sorry, there are too many cars on the road; we are going very slowly.

ai.zh: 可能两点半。没问题，我们能到。
ai.en: Maybe half past two. No problem, we can make it.
You are welcome. I will drive a bit faster.

you.en: I am going to the airport.

you.zh: 下午三点。我们能快一点吗？
you.en: Three in the afternoon. Can we go a bit faster?
Then what time can we get there?
All right, thank you.

phrases.en: Excuse me, where is the restroom?

phrases.zh: 你说得太快了，我听不懂。
phrases.en: You speak too fast; I cannot understand.
I do not know how to say it.
